mapper.select: SELECT source_no,source_type,order_no,payment_no,user_id,merchant_id,amount_cents,currency,state,version FROM refund_authorization WHERE source_no=#{sourceNo} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET fulfillment_lock='AFTERSALE',locked_aftersale_no=#{sourceNo},version=version+1 WHERE order_no=#{orderNo} AND status='PAID' AND fulfillment_lock='NONE'
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM order_item WHERE order_no=#{orderNo} ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
SELECT u.*,i.sku_id AS sku_id FROM order_item_unit u JOIN order_item i ON i.id=u.order_item_id WHERE i.order_no=#{orderNo} ORDER BY u.order_item_id,u.unit_no FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE order_item_unit SET reserved_refund_cents=paid_amount_cents,active_aftersale_no=#{sourceNo},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND active_aftersale_no IS NULL AND reserved_refund_cents=0 AND succeeded_refund_cents=0 AND return_state='NONE'
UPDATE order_item SET reserved_refund_cents=line_amount_cents,version=version+1 WHERE order_no=#{orderNo} AND reserved_refund_cents=0 AND succeeded_refund_cents=0

UPDATE order_item_unit u JOIN order_item i ON i.id=u.order_item_id SET u.reserved_refund_cents=0,u.active_aftersale_no=NULL,u.return_state=IF(u.return_state='RESERVED','NONE',u.return_state),u.version=u.version+1 WHERE i.order_no=#{orderNo} AND u.active_aftersale_no=#{sourceNo}

UPDATE order_item SET reserved_refund_cents=(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(u.reserved_refund_cents),0) FROM order_item_unit u WHERE u.order_item_id=order_item.id),succeeded_refund_cents=(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(u.succeeded_refund_cents),0) FROM order_item_unit u WHERE u.order_item_id=order_item.id),returned_qty=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_item_unit u WHERE u.order_item_id=order_item.id AND u.return_state='RECEIVED'),version=version+1 WHERE order_no=#{orderNo}

UPDATE order_item_unit u JOIN order_item i ON i.id=u.order_item_id SET u.succeeded_refund_cents=u.succeeded_refund_cents+u.reserved_refund_cents,u.reserved_refund_cents=0,u.active_aftersale_no=NULL,u.version=u.version+1 WHERE i.order_no=#{orderNo} AND u.active_aftersale_no=#{sourceNo}

UPDATE order_item SET reserved_refund_cents=(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(u.reserved_refund_cents),0) FROM order_item_unit u WHERE u.order_item_id=order_item.id),succeeded_refund_cents=(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(u.succeeded_refund_cents),0) FROM order_item_unit u WHERE u.order_item_id=order_item.id),returned_qty=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_item_unit u WHERE u.order_item_id=order_item.id AND u.return_state='RECEIVED'),version=version+1 WHERE order_no=#{orderNo}
UPDATE orders SET status='SHIPPED',shipped_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),version=version+1 WHERE order_no=#{orderNo} AND status='PAID' AND fulfillment_lock='NONE' AND stock_sync_status='CONFIRMED'
UPDATE orders SET status='COMPLETED',completed_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),version=version+1 WHERE order_no=#{orderNo} AND status='SHIPPED'
mapper.select: SELECT o.order_no FROM orders o LEFT JOIN refund_authorization a ON a.source_no=CONCAT('CLOSE:',o.order_no) WHERE o.close_phase='LATE_PAYMENT' AND a.source_no IS NULL ORDER BY o.id LIMIT 10
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status='CLOSED',stock_sync_status='RELEASED',closed_at=COALESCE(closed_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)),close_reason='LATE_PAYMENT_REFUNDED',version=version+1 WHERE order_no=#{orderNo} AND status IN ('CLOSING','CLOSED') AND close_phase='LATE_PAYMENT'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM refund_flow_task WHERE (state='READY' AND next_retry_at<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) OR (state='RUNNING' AND lease_until<UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
SELECT * FROM refund_flow_task WHERE source_no=#{sourceNo} AND state='RUNNING' AND claim_version=#{claimVersion} AND lease_until>UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO idempotency_request(actor_type,actor_id,operation,idempotency_key,request_hash,business_no,state) VALUES(#{actorType},#{actorId},#{operation},#{idempotencyKey},#{requestHash},#{businessNo},'SUCCEEDED') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id
mapper.select: SELECT request_hash,business_no FROM idempotency_request WHERE actor_type=#{actorType} AND actor_id=#{actorId} AND operation=#{operation} AND idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey} FOR UPDATE
SELECT source_no FROM refund_flow_task WHERE source_no=#{sourceNo} FOR UPDATE
SELECT source_no,refund_no,step,state,attempt_count,last_error,next_retry_at,claim_version FROM refund_flow_task ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE refund_flow_task SET state='READY',attempt_count=0,claim_version=claim_version+1,lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL,next_retry_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),last_error=NULL,refund_no=COALESCE(#{refundNo},refund_no) WHERE source_no=#{sourceNo} AND state='MANUAL_REVIEW'
